params.baseline_path: sentient_style: whole vault (600 KB cap) + 5 raw samples x 6 recent contacts + 15 recent emails + raw thread; text only (no screenshot, generous to the baseline)
params.judge: model: a different model from the drafts: qwen3-8b-q4km (Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off) (drafts: qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)), temperature 0, pairwise, both orders (Nugget as A then as B), JSON verdict {voice, factuality, winner}, thread/context/drafts fenced as untrusted
params.judge.model: qwen3-8b-q4km (Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)
params.model: qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)
params.nugget_path: engine: nugget_draft::Drafter as nuggetd builds it (DraftConfig::default except grounding and temperature; text-only retrieval over the persona's store, default RetrieveConfig, fixed reference time; voice from the persona's sent messages, recipient or channel statistics + 3 exemplars)
params.sampling.seed: not sent: ChatRequest has no seed field, so the provider samples with its own seed (fixed temperature instead)
params.voice_metric: in_suite stylometric distance (bench/src/suites/draft/style.rs); switches to nugget_voice::style_distance when it lands
